description: This PHP file defines the LeaveTypeDao class, which provides data access methods for LeaveType entities in the OrangeHRM project. It includes functions for retrieving, saving, deleting, and searching leave types, as well as handling related entities and filtering.

classes.name: LeaveTypeDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for managing LeaveType entities, providing CRUD operations and search capabilities.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeList
methods.description: Returns a list of all non-deleted LeaveType entities ordered by name.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeById
methods.description: Retrieves a LeaveType entity by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingLeaveTypeIds
methods.description: Fetches IDs of leave types from a given list of IDs that are not marked as deleted.

methods.name: saveLeaveType
methods.description: Persists a LeaveType entity to the database.

methods.name: deleteLeaveType
methods.description: Marks specified LeaveType entities as deleted.

methods.name: getDeletedLeaveTypeList
methods.description: Returns a list of all LeaveType entities marked as deleted.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeByName
methods.description: Fetches a LeaveType entity by its name if it exists and is not deleted.

methods.name: undeleteLeaveType
methods.description: Restores a previously deleted LeaveType entity by setting its deleted flag to false.

methods.name: searchLeaveType
methods.description: Searches for leave types based on filter parameters, returning matching LeaveType entities.

methods.name: getSearchLeaveTypePaginator
methods.description: Configures and returns a paginator for searching leave types based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchLeaveTypesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of leave types matching search criteria.

methods.name: hasEmployeeAllocatedLeavesForLeaveType
methods.description: Checks if an employee has allocated leaves for a specific leave type.
